$comment: Windows persistent variant. SessionStart hook re-injects SAD context via PowerShell; PreToolUse calls .ps1 helpers. Installer (sad-init.ps1 -Persistent) selects this on Windows.

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Content -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue AGENTS.md, .sad/rules/core/README.md, .sad/state/sad-state.md; Write-Output '---'; Get-Content -TotalCount 80 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue .sad/memory/constitution.md; Write-Output '---'; try { & .sad/scripts/next-step.ps1 } catch { }"

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"SAD pre-spec: feature.spec.md is governed by .sad/memory/constitution.md, the non-technical tier context in .sad/stakeholders/non-technical.md, and .sad/rules/core/README.md. See hooks/pre-spec.json."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"SAD pre-spec: feature.spec.md is governed by .sad/memory/constitution.md, the non-technical tier context in .sad/stakeholders/non-technical.md, and .sad/rules/core/README.md. See hooks/pre-spec.json."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"SAD post-reconcile: reconciliation.md changed. It needs semi-technical reviewer sign-off, and /sad-compound is the next lifecycle step. See hooks/post-reconcile.json."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"SAD post-reconcile: reconciliation.md changed. It needs semi-technical reviewer sign-off, and /sad-compound is the next lifecycle step. See hooks/post-reconcile.json."}}'
